title: Data Analytics Projects - GeeksforGeeks
content:
This article presents 30+ Data Analytics projects with free source code to help beginners, students and professionals gain real-world, hands-on experience. Whether you are building your first analytics project or strengthening your resume with industry-relevant work, these projects cover essential concepts such as data collection, cleaning, visualization and time-series analysis.

  • Once you understand basic statistics, Excel and Python, practicing with small analytics projects is the best way to build confidence.
  • These projects focus on data collection, analysis and visualization using real datasets.

Data Analysis and Visualization Projects

These projects focus on data cleaning, exploratory data analysis (EDA), visualization and predictive insights using structured datasets.

  1. Zomato Data Analysis
  2. IPL Data Analysis
  3. Airbnb Data Analysis
  4. Global Covid-19 Data Analysis and Visualizations
  5. Housing Price Analysis & Predictions
  6. Titanic Dataset Analysis and Survival Predictions
  7. Iris Flower Dataset Analysis and Predictions
  8. Customer Churn Analysis
  9. Car Price Prediction Analysis
  10. Indian Election Data Analysis
  11. HR Analytics to Track Employee Performance
  12. Product Recommendation Analysis
  13. Credit Card Approvals Analysis & Predictions
  14. Uber Trips Data Analysis
  15. Active Product Sales Analysis
  16. Google Search Analysis

Time Series Data Analytics Projects

Time series projects deal with data collected over time and help you understand trends, seasonality, forecasting and anomaly detection.

  1. Stock Price Time Series Analysis
  2. Weather Data Analysis
  3. Time Series Analysis with Cryptocurrency Data
  4. Climate Change Data Analysis
  5. Anomaly Detection in Time Series Data
  6. Predictive Modeling for Sales or Demand Forecasting
  7. Air Quality Data Analysis and Dynamic Visualizations
  8. Gold Price Analysis and Forcasting Over Time
  9. Food Price Forecasting

WebScraping Data Analytics Projects

Web scraping projects teach you how to collect raw data from websites and transform it into useful insights through analysis.

  1. Movies Review Scraping And Analysis
  2. Product Price Scraping and Analysis
  3. News Scraping and Analysis
  4. Real-time Share Price scrapping and analysis

Best Platforms to Build Data Analyst Projects

Choosing the right tools is essential for building efficient and scalable data analytics projects. Below are some of the most commonly used platforms in the industry.

  1. Microsoft Excel: Suitable for beginners and quick data exploration
  2. Python (Pandas and NumPy): Ideal for data manipulation, analysis and automation
  3. RStudio: Best for statistical analysis and research-based projects
  4. Tableau: Used for creating interactive dashboards and visual stories
  5. Jupyter Notebooks: Interactive environment for analysis and documentation
  6. Google Colab: Cloud-based notebooks with free computing resources
  7. Microsoft Azure: Powerful platform for big data analytics and large datasets

Select a platform based on your project requirements, dataset size, collaboration needs and visualization goals.
